about: Every line the story scripts can speak, read from src/story by tools/audio/voice-inventory.mjs. Generated: do not edit by hand.

countingRules.chars: Unicode code points of the line text as the dialogue box prints it; ElevenLabs bills the text it is sent, so audio tags and retakes add to this.
countingRules.voiced: "no" for captions (speaker none outside the two NPC scripts), silent beats (ellipsis only) and speakers who never speak.
countingRules.uniqueVoicedChars: Voiced characters counting an identical (voice, treatment, text) once: what is billed if a repeated line shares one take.
countingRules.kinds: say, narrate (the retrospective narrator), quip (victory tally), fallback (an authored stand-in when the written speaker is not on the field).
countingRules.speech: estSpeechMs = chars / 15 per second + 250 ms; a planning figure, replaced by the recorded duration once a line exists.
countingRules.ids: <chapter>.<script part>.<NNN>; kept while chapter, part, speaker and text are unchanged, new lines take the next number, edits retire the old id (never reused).
